services.name: Our Classes
services.desc: More than just another after-school activity, K.I.C.K. MASTERS is a fun and disciplined experience. Our structured and enjoyable classroom settings captivate children's attention, enhancing their learning capabilities. Through this learning process, children develop a profound sense of accomplishment, laying the initial groundwork for a strong foundation of self-confidence. Experience a unique fusion of three martial arts enhancing character, self-discipline, and focus. Karate builds personal traits, while Kickboxing blends effective techniques for a great cardio workout.The combination of Karate and Kickboxing enables you to defend yourself in stand-up situations, preventing close contact.
